_comment: Biome table for procedural terrain. Each column samples temperature + moisture (domain-warped, 4-octave low-frequency noise) + continentalness. The biome whose climate-cell CENTRE (mid of its temp/moisture ranges) is nearest the column's climate supplies materials. heightScale/heightOffset shape elevation and blend smoothly across biomes (no cliffs). surfaceAlt + surfaceAltChance scatter a second surface material in patches (e.g. a dirty forest floor). Materials are names from materials.json.
